text:

Technology stocks were lower in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing about 0.7% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling 0.4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Alarm.com Holdings ( ALRM ) rose 4% on Thursday after the cloud-based home protection applications company reported improved Q3 earnings compared with year-ago levels and beating Wall Street expectations.
In other sector news:
(+) CyberArk Software ( CYBR ) touched a record high on Thursday, rising to a best-ever $84.21, after reporting adjusted Q3 net income of $0.48 per share, exceeding the consensus by $0.21 per share. The software firm also raised its FY18 forecast above Street views.
(-) CommScope Holding ( COMM ) dropped to its lowest price since 2014, falling 23%, after missing analyst projections with its Q3 financial results and saying it is buying telecom equipment maker Arris International ( ARRS ) for $7.4 billion. Under terms of the proposed transaction, CommScope will pay $31.75 in cash for each Arris share, representing a 14.2% premium over Wednesday's closing price.
